result.title: Taming Noise Initialization for Zero-shot Video Restoration with Image Diffusion Priors
result.summary: Recent advances in diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in restoring high-quality images in a zero-shot manner. Unfortunately, extending this success to video restoration is challenging due to the substantial computational resources required to pre-train video diffusion models. A rising trend seeks to address video restoration by utilizing a pre-trained image diffusion model, initiating restoration from either frame-wise independent or identical Gaussian noise. Yet, these approaches often fall short, as such simple noise initiations fail to capture and utilize the inherent temporal correlations within degraded video frames. In this work, we propose taming noise initialization for zero-shot video restoration, which preserves the intrinsic temporal correlations by generating initial noises directly using DDIM inversion on the corrupted video frames themselves. Building on this, we introduce an adaptive noise blending strategy that suppresses degradation patterns encoded during DDIM inversion while gradually steering the noise toward a Gaussian distribution. To further emphasize temporal consistency, we propose measurement-guided trajectory attention to better align features across frames. Extensive experiments on multiple video restoration tasks demonstrate that our method outperforms existing zero-shot approaches, consistently achieving superior results on the DAVIS, REDS4, and Set8 datasets.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究零样本视频复原中扩散噪声初始化的设计：用 DDIM inversion 从退化视频帧直接生成初始噪声以保留时序相关性，再通过自适应噪声混合抑制退化模式并逐步逼近高斯分布，并引入测量引导的轨迹注意力增强跨帧特征对齐。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「由观测反演得到初始状态、再逐步混合回先验」的机制，与 LVR 中如何在 latent 初态注入视觉证据并及时衰减退化信息、以及跨帧证据对齐，可能构成可核查的对应线索。
